camera.reason: 8MP f/2.0 main camera with only a QVGA auxiliary lens, no OIS.

performance.reason: Unisoc T603 with 3GB RAM is an entry chip that lags in daily use.

battery.reason: 5,000mAh lasts a full day, but 10W charging is slow.

display.reason: 6.71 inch HD+ LCD at 90Hz with 500 nits.

build.reason: Glass back and Gorilla Glass 3 front on a plastic frame, but no IP rating.

software.reason: Xiaomi promises 2 Android upgrades and 3 years of security patches.

value.reason: Only phone in the bracket with a 2 upgrade promise and a glass back, at 19,000.

availability.reason: Out of stock at PriceOye; only third-party Daraz sellers had stock on 2026-10-10.

notes: Price is WhatMobile's official listing (18,999). PriceOye lists 3GB 64GB at 19,899 but out of stock, so ignored. Third-party Daraz sellers (not official stores) list it at 19,499 and 20,999. Xiaomi Pakistan no longer has a product page for it. The rear auxiliary lens (0.08MP) is omitted from cameras because it is not a usable camera. Weight from WhatMobile.
